ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.10.0 Lean MT Rebase
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.10.0 Lean MT Rebase for RimWorld 1.5. This release returns the project to its original goal: reduce main-thread spikes while moving safe immutable computation to worker cores. Production keeps the optimizations that demonstrated useful work in long-run reports, including S5.1/S4 JobGiver search acceleration, RC2 large-set rescue, persistent DoBill readiness filtering, the Common Sense ingredient-expansion memo, ReachProfile, haul accelerators, text caching and PathGrid topology invalidation. The generic zero-yield GenClosest fabric consumer, DoBill worker-tail path, Resumable JobGiver and V0.9.12 Predictive Admission are removed from the production DLL. New ReachProfile snapshot captures are pressure-capped to prevent main-thread capture bursts. Vanilla remains authoritative at final gameplay decision boundaries and all acceleration paths remain fail-closed.
